mapper.select: SELECT stock_lot_id, location_code, customer_name, product_model, furnace_no, furnace_layer, opening_qty, transfer_qty, inbound_qty, outbound_qty, return_qty, warehouse_qty, package_weight, warehouse_qty * package_weight AS stock_weight FROM matrix_data ORDER BY location_code, customer_name, product_model, furnace_no, furnace_layer, stock_lot_id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT SUM(opening_qty) AS opening_qty, SUM(transfer_qty) AS transfer_qty, SUM(inbound_qty) AS inbound_qty, SUM(outbound_qty) AS outbound_qty, SUM(return_qty) AS return_qty, SUM(warehouse_qty) AS warehouse_qty, SUM(warehouse_qty * package_weight) AS stock_weight FROM matrix_data

SELECT stock_lot_id, biz_date, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('OPENING','PRODUCTION_IN','INBOUND','ADJUST_IN') THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS inbound_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('OUTBOUND','ADJUST_OUT') THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('TRANSFER_IN','TRANSFER_OUT') THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS transfer_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'RETURN_IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS return_qty FROM rd_stock_transaction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND biz_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND stock_lot_id IN #{id} GROUP BY stock_lot_id, biz_date ORDER BY stock_lot_id, biz_date
